{"notes": "Visit 3 (left 7:30). Nobody spoke while I was there; no hand labels visible. Picture: whole fish still dark/connected: nose at start, both body arcs, crossing near (23,10), both tail tips (upper to about 27.5,4.5; lower to about 27,15.5). Nothing pale or stranded. Lower tail (about 25.5-27, 13-15) still tightly bunched but standing and connected. Possible weak point for the push, but holding. Team seems to be respecting hands-off.

Maya: No new observation. Earlier she volunteered that she nudged a domino near the lower tail, and it's intact. Good ownership and honesty. Still don't know what she built.

Leo: No new observation. Earlier he set a clear stop-touching rule and repeated it. Good process and leadership; his connectivity claim held up. Still need his own build contribution.

Priya: No new observation. She backed hands-off and said the back line looks solid. Too little evidence for impact or execution.

Tom: Absent from view and silent for three visits now. No evidence either way. Don't assume he did nothing; don't rate until I ask him directly.

Next: ask each person privately what they built and who did what, Tom first. Re-check lower tail before the push. Hold ratings until I have more than the shared picture, since I can't tell who placed which domino. The finished fish looks good as a team result, but that credit isn't individual."}
